owner_creation.analysis: The version private pointer is initialized to the static Revision 1.15 byte literal, not malloc storage; pr_version only reads this fixed revision.
owner_creation.invariant: The revision pointer borrows a static NUL literal.

aliases_escapes.analysis: pr_version copies the version pointer into local p and extracts the known short 1.15 text into a ten-byte stack buffer; neither alias escapes printf.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Revision aliases remain within the display call.
limitations: Private single-invocation helper state only; metachars heap ownership and lstrtol arithmetic remain separate pending entries.

callback_targets.analysis: pr_version calls printf directly; the version pointer is string data and never converted into a function pointer.
callback_targets.invariant: The revision field cannot dispatch code.

invalidation.analysis: No maintained assignment replaces this version private pointer after static initialization; its literal outlives the local scan.
invalidation.invariant: The displayed revision cannot outlive its literal.

mutation_commit.analysis: The version initializer supplies the entire terminated revision before helper main; extraction commits a local terminator before printf.
mutation_commit.invariant: The printed stack buffer is terminated before use.

release_pair.analysis: The lessecho version pointer borrows a literal and must not be freed; the extraction array is a local stack value.
release_pair.invariant: Borrowed revision bytes have no allocator pair.

error_cleanup.analysis: pr_version stops at NUL if no space exists; the fixed version literal bounds the extracted revision to fit its ten-byte array.
error_cleanup.invariant: The reviewed literal bounds the extraction length.

signals_handoff.analysis: The helper installs no application signal handler that edits this private version pointer; SIGPIPE can terminate output but not replace the owner.
signals_handoff.invariant: Helper signals do not write revision state.
